QuestInfo.name: Luke the Security Man's Wish to Travel
QuestInfo.0: You hear that Luke the Security Guy made up his mind on something...
QuestInfo.1: You meet Luke at the entrance of the dungeon. Now that his mom's had her fill of Snake Drink, Luke wants to leave his boring life behind and see the world. Silas Irons of Perion says he can make good traveling gloves for Luke with #b1 Black Feather, 30 Dragon Skins, and 3 Horns of Taurospear#k. And, of course, he wants you to collect them for him. Luke says that the fairies in Ellinia may know something about the feather...
QuestInfo.2: I got Luke all the materials he needed for the nice glove, and return, he gave me a very precious item that has been passed down from generation to generation, an #bold bronze normal Helm#k. I feel like I'm losing out on this deal...but I can't get mad at him since it's been passed down from generation to generation. I heard Mr. Thunder can make this helmet even better...I should go there sometime later.

0.0: Hey! You're the one that helped me make a tasty Snake Drink for my mom! You look much stronger then before! Maybe you will even surpass me one day... Actually, that's not going to happen, hahahaha...
0.1: To be honest, I'm sick of being a security guard. I want to take a trip! But first, I need some good equipment. I visited #p1022004# in #m102000000#, and he needs me to gather some RIDICULOUS materials for the armor I want! Argh.
0.2: I want to be an adventurer like you, so, uh, can you get me the materials #p1022004# needs? I tried, but I couldn't do it. Don't worry, I'll pay you well for your work. Win-win, right?

yes.0: Yes! Actually, I really wanted to make some nice gloves... I'll need #b1 #t4031042#, 30 #t4000030#s, and 3 #t4000046#s#k. You know, the fairies might know something about the #b#t4031042##k... Right, if you get me those materials, I'll give you something real nice!

no.0: You must be really busy right now. If you ever have spare time, please come back and do me that favor! It's very important to me!

1.0: Oh my goodness! I can't believe you got it all. Sweet! Once I get this to #p1022004#, I'm going to get one incredible pair of gloves... Here, take this. It's a helmet that's been passed down from generation to generation in my family... maybe Mr. Thunder can make a better one out of it.

yes.0: You got the #b#t1002100##k, right? Thanks for your work. It'll definitely help you on your journey! Well then, back to making more gear...

item.0: Still no materials? Get me #b1 #t4031042#, 30 #t4000030#s, and 3 #t4000046#s#k! The fairies might know something about the #b#t4031042##k if you don't.
